title: The structural Union proof only constructs a superset of the desired union.
details: Revision2014-09-06, Lemma10.15 printed/PDF p.29. The proposed name includes every second-level subname with the top condition. Its value contains the union but can contain values whose attached outer or inner condition is absent from G. At this stage Separation has not been established, so containment alone does not prove Union. Repair: use the name consisting of (chi,r) for an outer pair (pi,p) in sigma, inner pair (chi,q) in pi, and r stronger than both p and q. Upward closure gives the forward inclusion; directedness inside G gives the reverse. The bounded construction belongs to the ground model and evaluates exactly to the union. Alternatively postpone the axiom conclusion until Separation is available.
